returned_body:
## Current roadmap checkpoint — 30 October 2026 20:18 UTC

**Still draft / not production-ready. Iteration 1 is accepted within its bounded four-type contract.** Iteration 2 is in fresh deep research; iterations 3–10 remain queued in order.

- Complete accepted source: `e42a8adc0f6f6f3c0b4eca903016a61bab4c3f67`, including native, typed persistence/migration, independent browser reference and portable offline verification.
- Exact final v1 export preserved first at `fcc3e71f0aa49069dd35384bf17f008421696e4d`: all 218 source/evidence entries plus manifest verified. Original/frozen source and deployed private v1 Site remain unchanged.
- Actual **unstable DuckDB C API v2**, exact v2.0.0 host/header pin, genuine `C_STRUCT_UNSTABLE` metadata, extension version 0.2.0. Typed logical function `td_query_v2` is a separate versioned API; legacy `td_query` remains available. No loader checks bypassed.
- Strict disjoint string/bool/int64/finite-float64 values survive literals, interning, recursive joins, ordering, storage and results. No implicit coercion; JavaScript uses exact decimal-string/BigInt int64 and temporal cuts. Unsupported value families are rejected explicitly. Migration preserves historical strings without reinterpretation.
- Passed: **57 typed native**, **29 independent SQL/native**, **22 legacy native**, **23 legacy storage**, **26 real migration**, **96 browser groups**, **122 external browser contract checks**, core/fuzz/frozen-baseline comparisons, actual binding ASan/UBSan with leak detection off, genuine missing-engine persistence/rollback, and complete offline `verify_typed.sh`. Categories overlap; this is not certification.
- Normal typed artifact `5b661f38…cb6270d` and same-frozen-core API-only control `69916109…52e0b4f` reproduce bit-for-bit on this host/compiler. DuckDB 1.4.3 correctly rejects the exact-host v2 artifact.
- Initial process-isolated full-path timings observed 23–36% losses. A tighter 756-pair / 1,512-sample CPU-pinned serial A/B study across both load orders and two processes did not reproduce a large regression (paired medians roughly 0.97–1.03×). Both data sets are preserved; a large causal ABI regression is not established. A compact host-transport proposal was slower and rejected. Typed STRUCT-to-Python conversion remains a measured cost; no universal speedup claim.
- Durable acceptance/evidence checkpoint on main: `eb8e09ed64beb6f45cbd524378264be2d1f54ce1`. Curated evidence archive SHA256 `4e279aaa6bdea3c1ab00df0073064bd558d48eb57cdf6f45bc735e388777f16b`; raw samples, failed setup runs and provenance retained. Three reproducible ELF build outputs excluded from the published derivative with exact identities recorded; original local archives unchanged.
- Items 2–10, full allocator/cancellation coverage, crash/restore, SQL-first planning, negation/aggregates, incremental maintenance, interval history and Triplex conformance are **not complete**. No deployment, merge, force push or resource deletion performed.

[Bounded acceptance]([PRIVATE_REFERENCE_REMOVED]) · [implementation contract](projects/temporal-datalog/prototype/engine/ITERATION-01.md) · ordered roadmap (private application reference omitted). Historical v1 description and measurements below are retained, not claims about the changed build.

<!-- dot-roadmap-current-end -->

## Original prototype description (historical)

## Goal
Investigate native DuckDB Datalog over EAV bitemporal facts, with rigorous matched SQL benchmarks and a private playable Site. Code is saved here per Contributor's explicit wiki/code destination, not as a production toolkit release.

## First meaningful checkpoint
- Real C++ native loadable extension through stable v1.2.0 C extension ABI; same binary LOAD/evaluation verified in DuckDB2.0.0 and1.4.3.
- Bounded positive Datalog, indexed semi-naive evaluation, temporal [from,to) snapshot selection, string-only values. No arbitrary SQL/IO in callbacks.
- Browser reference implementation and synthetic timeline UI (not DuckDB/WASM).
- Source-pinned Triplex API and compatibility research; no drop-in adapter claim.
- Native and independent SQL/oracle test harnesses; initial14workload x21sample benchmark completed locally, mixed wins and regressions (raw evidence to follow).

## Verification so far
Independent initial585 comparisons passed; browser10test groups passed. These are prototype checks, not launch certification. Runtime2.0 uses unstable-v2-free stable v1 ABI; deep optimizer/storage APIs are NOT implemented.

## Work in progress
Measured performance rounds, persisted transactional wrapper, independent native code review, final conformance and raw benchmark evidence, source provenance/readiness report, Site browser QA and private deployment. Keep draft; no merge/publication authorization inferred.

## Current roadmap checkpoint — 30 October 2026 19:09 UTC

**Still draft / not production-ready.** Iteration 1 is in integration and renewed performance research; iterations 2–10 remain queued.

- Exact final v1 export preserved first at `fcc3e71f0aa49069dd35384bf17f008421696e4d`: all 218 source/evidence entries plus manifest verified.
- Current native implementation checkpoint: `0d9d55138b13f5ac5fea5ca32df6251250cb7d9b`. Actual **unstable DuckDB C API v2**, exact v2.0.0 host/header pin, genuine `C_STRUCT_UNSTABLE` metadata, extension version 0.2.0. No version checks bypassed.
- Added strict tagged values, shared compact-ID kernel, selection-aware primitive readers / explicit nested normalization, owned result encoding and checked offline vendored-header recovery. Legacy logical API remains available.
- Passed: real native LOAD, **57 typed native checks**, **29 independent SQL/native cases**, **22 legacy native tests**, **23 legacy storage tests**, and three positive/negative header-recovery controls. The legacy metadata-version assertion alone intentionally changes 0.1.0 to 0.2.0.
- Typed artifact `5b661f38…cb6270d` and separate same-frozen-core API-only control `69916109…52e0b4f` reproduced bit-for-bit on this host/compiler with unchanged pre/post source hashes. Old DuckDB 1.4.3 correctly rejects the new exact-host artifact.
- Typed browser and migration/store work has genuine local passing evidence (including 26 migration acceptance cases), but those source additions are **not yet in this native-only checkpoint**. Browser adversarial iterator correction and final sanitizer/unit closeout remain in progress.
- Initial process-isolated full-path measurements observed 23–36% losses in two cases. A tighter 756-pair / 1,512-sample, CPU-pinned serial A/B rerun across both load orders and two processes did not reproduce a large regression (paired medians roughly 0.97–1.03×). Both data sets are preserved; process/host drift is material, and a large causal ABI regression is not established. Typed STRUCT-to-Python conversion is a separate measured cost. **No universal speedup or production readiness claim.**
- Original/frozen source and deployed v1 Site remain unchanged. No deployment, merge or resource deletion performed.

See [native checkpoint details](projects/temporal-datalog/prototype/engine/ITERATION-01.md) and ordered roadmap (private application reference omitted). Existing benchmark exports below are historical v1 evidence, not measurements of the changed native build.
